summary_for_children: Al-Ahqaf means The Wind-Curved Sandhills. It tells of Hud warning 'Ad in the dunes, and teaches kindness to parents. It mentions jinn who listened to the Quran.
environment_concept: Winding dunes where the people of 'Ad saw a cloud and thought it was rain, and a quiet valley where a group of jinn listened to the Quran, shown only as stillness.
architecture_and_scenery: Curved sand dunes, empty dwellings, an approaching dark cloud, and a quiet night valley.

palette.lighting: Hot dune light, then storm darkness

areas.name: Listening Valley
areas.description: A quiet night valley; nothing unseen is shown.

activities.name: Kindness to parents
activities.description: Help with small tasks at home in a mini-game (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Listen quietly
activities.description: Sit still while a recitation-free ayah card is read.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration keeps Hud and the jinn unseen.

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
